title: Canyon database query (seam 3)
description: POST /api/v1/projects/:id/db/query: one statement run as the person, in a database session the route opens or attaches to (contracts/routes.md, Database sessions; design/DATABASE-SESSIONS.md §8). The routes.md row is canonical; this schema pins the body, the answer and the query's own refusals. The golden is contracts/testdata/db-session/meridian.json, checked against db-session.schema.json, which refers here.

sql.description: One statement, at most 64 KiB; more than one is the database's refusal (400 invalid_sql), never a parse of Canyon's.

reason.description: Required in prod when the query opens a database session or is its sign-in's first attach; later ones need none.

timeout.description: The statement's timeout as Go's time.ParseDuration reads it (30s, 1.5s, 5m0s), 1s to 5m; 30s when absent.

type.description: The column's type as Postgres's format_type names it: bigint, character varying(80).

rows.description: Postgres's text output, NULL as null, in the columns' order.

truncated.description: Cut at a row boundary at the limit or at 10 MiB.
